# Keep Panorama schema fixtures synchronized with database creation

Current CreateNewDatabase explicitly asks maintainers to keep xpcshell/head.js in sync. The fixture creates the same folder columns and parent/name uniqueness before loading the service. Proposed testing rule in this component: update the fixture schema with production schema changes and still inspect each constraint, rather than treating fixture construction as a migration test. These source sections were read; the fixture was not executed. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Panorama test schema.
